title: Herbs for the Lakes
offer: Autumn comes, and the animals catch colds. Take my herbs to those who need them: two bundles to the horse farm, two to the herders, two to Gudrun's inn.

herbs.name: Herbs
herbs.counted: {count|a bundle of herbs|{count} bundles of herbs}

steps.say: Herbs from Tova! Now the cow and the calf stay well all winter.
All delivered? You are real helpers now. Take these herbs for your own animals.

fact: Healers dried herbs in bundles under the roof, to have them all winter.
